node.statement: After node 1.1 is validated, epsilon<=e_env^0 for the same witnesses frozen before W. The singleton U={j} is nonempty, the root supplies the same finite-dimensional extended epsilon-C*-algebra A and the same extended W.c0_cb*epsilon-inclusion w, and W.c0_cb is the c0 witness used for lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope in lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger. Applying lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope to U={j} gives P_U=w(e_j)=P_j and makes the exact vector space A_U=S^A_{P_U}=S^A_{P_j} an extended L^0*epsilon-C*-algebra. Denote the unit furnished on this exact space by I_{S_{P_j}}; by the algebra typing, I_{S_{P_j}} is an element of S_{P_j}.
